Container.Name: Contrack
Container.Overview: Self-hosted personal CRM for managing contacts, notes, interactions, and relationships in one SQLite database. Search runs locally on built-in CPU models, and AI providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or an OpenAI-compatible server) are optional and configured inside the app. Sign-in is enabled by default; open the WebUI after first start to create the admin account. All database files, uploads, snapshots, and the encryption key live in /mnt/user/appdata/contrack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: crm contacts personal-crm relationships address-book sqlite mcp

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Contrack WebUI and API.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for curator.db, uploads, backups, and secret.key.

Config.Name: Require Sign-In
Config.Description: Require account sign-in (true or false). Keep true whenever the port is reachable beyond localhost; first visit creates the admin account.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional external root origin with http or https and no path (for example https://crm.example.com) when behind a reverse proxy. Used for passkeys, mail links, OAuth, and CSRF checks.

Config.Name: Reverse Proxy Hops
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front of Contrack (0 to 10). Set to 1 behind a single reverse proxy so X-Forwarded-* headers are trusted.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated hostnames allowed before the first account is created or while sign-in is off (for example nas.tail1234.ts.net).
